items.text: Zay Flowers (hamstring) returned to practice Friday after consecutive DNPs Wed/Thu. Encouraging step; likely Questionable/GTD vs Saints after Week 1 exit.
items.why: Missed first two practices; Friday return after hamstring aggravation in W1.
items.implication: Monitor final report/warmups; start if cleared, have Bateman backup.
items.opportunity: If OUT reverse beneficiaries; if IN full WR1 role with Lane on IR.

items.text: Bills ruled DJ Moore OUT TNF (shoulder); AC joint sprain, not serious, day-to-day. Chance to play next week vs Chargers but not lock.
items.why: Landed hard on shoulder TNF; X-rays, AC sprain confirmed by sources.
items.implication: Out for TNF; monitor Week 3. Fast start interrupted.
items.opportunity: Short-term BUF WR targets to others; Keon Coleman etc if available.

items.text: Ladd McConkey (ribs) DNP second straight day Thursday; Schefter: making it unlikely available Sunday vs Raiders. Worked to side with trainer.
items.why: Consecutive DNPs post-W1 exit; ribs day-to-day but no practice progress.
items.implication: Plan without McConkey; QJ and Tre Harris elevate.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets to Quentin Johnston (Berry note) and Harris (ETR waiver).

items.text: Nico Collins (hamstring) DNP Thursday after Wednesday practice injury; doctors do not believe serious (Grade 1) but Week 2 status vs Bengals in jeopardy. Not spotted at Friday practice start, trending toward OUT.
items.why: Hamstring strain history (missed 5 games 2024); consecutive DNPs post-MRI; heavy Week 1 routes (37/42 dropbacks).
items.implication: Sit Collins; monitor official designation. HOU WR depth thins further (Higgins/Dell already out).
items.opportunity: Routes/targets redistribute to Hutchinson, Boutte, Noel; Schultz TE upside.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson: “I’m ready to go.” Unclear how much he earns vs Rhamondre Stevenson, but returning at right time—Pats desperate for explosives with AJ Brown (ankle) IR; strong upcoming matchups pre-W11 bye (PIT/JAX/BUF/LV/NYJ/CHI/MIA/GB/DET).
items.why: Ankle healed; Brown IR creates need for playmakers; schedule window.
items.implication: Handcuff/stash with upside; monitor split vs Stevenson.
items.opportunity: Carries/routes/explosive role expansion possible vs PIT debut.

items.text: Brock Bowers (knee, post-meniscus trim) DNP again Thursday; has yet to practice since surgery. Unlikely Week 2 vs Chargers.
items.why: No practice since surgery; consecutive DNPs.
items.implication: Sit Bowers; Mayer primary TE fill-in.

items.text: If Zay Flowers (hamstring) can't go, Ravens WRs hierarchy: 1. Rashod Bateman 2. Devontez Walker 3. LaJohntay Wester 4. Elijah Sarratt 5. Chris Moore. Ja'Kobi Lane already IR (wrist).
items.why: Lane IR + Flowers uncertainty creates clear pecking order for targets behind Lamar.
items.implication: Bateman primary beneficiary/flex if Flowers sits; reverse if Flowers active Friday practice holds.
items.opportunity: Target share/routes expand for Bateman/Walker in 3WR sets.

items.text: Kenneth Walker LOVE vs IND: handled 21/24 RB touches through 3Q (74% snaps), 40% target share on routes (tied team lead), 24% overall target share W1 debut with KC. IND gave up 163 yds/3 TDs to Henry. #1 RB overall in range of outcomes if healthy.
items.why: Elite W1 utilization/target share in new offense; smash matchup.
items.opportunity: Snaps, carries, targets, RZ all high; three-down role.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty LOVE @ LAC: Utilization Score 99 in W1 under Kubiak (only Bijan higher). 19% target share last 10; 25+ touches 3/4 recent. Overreaction to injury scare fading.

Pass-catcher LOVEs: Justin Jefferson @CHI (37% tgt share Wentz, 93 yds/18 PPG career w/ him); DeVonta Smith @TEN (27% tgt, 13.7 aDOT, TEN soft); Mike Evans vs MIA (25% RZ tgt, led routes, MIA corners weak); Dalton Kincaid vs DET (69% routes career-high, 77% snaps, DET soft to TEs).
items.opportunity: Target share, routes, aDOT, RZ for each.

items.text: ETR Week 2 waivers injury beneficiaries: Ladd McConkey=Tre’ Harris; Ja’Kobi Lane=Rashod Bateman/Chris Moore; A.J. Brown=Romeo Doubs/DeMario Douglas; Alvin Kamara=Kendre Miller. Also streaming notes and One Injury Away list.
items.why: Direct injury fallout mapping for available players.
items.implication: Prioritize these adds for role expansion.
items.opportunity: Snaps/targets/carries from absences (Brown IR, Lane IR, McConkey/Kamara status).

items.text: Bucky Irving LOVE vs CLE: RB9 util W1, career-high 26% target share, every RB RZ touch, out-routed Gainwell by 8. CLE allowed 121 rush/4.8 YPC.

HATEs: Travis Etienne @BAL (split rushes w/ Miller, air-heavy points, Kamara return squeezes, underdog script); Marvin Harrison Jr vs SEA (8% tgt share W1, 0 RZ, SEA tough on WRs); Brian Thomas Jr @DEN (DEN elite vs perimeter/deep, shoulder limited); Harold Fannin @TB (14% tgt lowest since W5'25, low aDOT, more competition + Watson).
items.why: Poor W1 usage + tough matchups/role threats.

items.text: Dak Prescott LOVE vs WAS despite soft W1: home 21.3 PPG last year; WAS torched 14.5 YPC/3 TDs W1; DAL top-5 implied total (27) in high-total game (50.5). Smash spot.
